newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent futures trades sideways, but trend soft.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent futures trades sideways, but trend soft.

text.p: IPE Brent futures were trading sideways in mid-afternoon business. Traders said NYMEX had offered little fresh direction but gas oil had scrubbed off some of its morning gains to put a softer emphasis on the market.
January Brent was trading 15 cents lower at $23.45 a barrel at 1543 GMT. December WTI was trading 17 cents off at $24.24, while January was off 14 cents at $24.10.

Traders said the expiry of the WTI options could provoke some volatility later today and the Brent market was just bouncing sideways looking for fresh direction, finding support at $23.35 and resistance at $23.45.
